artworks.title: Clement de Jonghe
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint and burin on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an etching of a person seated on a wooden chair. The person is facing forward with both arms resting, the left arm slightly higher than the right. They have a calm expression with defined facial features, including eyes, a nose, and slightly opened lips. Their shoulder-length wavy hair is partially visible under a wide-brimmed hat casting a shadow on the face. The person is wearing a buttoned shirt with a visible collar and a draped cloak, showing folds and texture. There is no visible jewelry or items held by the person. The background is plain with minimal etching lines, focusing on the person as the central subject.

artworks.title: Sick Woman with a Large White Headdress (Saskia)
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.3 x 5.2 cm (2 1/2 x 2 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of an older woman sitting with her head slightly turned to the left. She has facial features showing signs of age, such as wrinkles, and a somber expression. Her hair is mostly covered by a cloth, possibly a hat or headscarf. She is wearing bulky or layered clothing with folds and textures. There are no visible accessories. The background is plain with cross-hatched lines.

artworks.title: Allegory of Carnal Love
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures set against a natural backdrop. The drawing features a group of six figures, along with two smaller figures, who appear to be in a garden or wooded setting. The figures are depicted in various poses, some with arms raised. Around them, trees with sparse foliage frame the scene, and clouds are visible in the sky. The engraving is detailed, with careful attention to the human form and drapery. The scene is bustling with life, creating a lively tableau with dynamic interactions between the figures and their surroundings.

artworks.title: Cover Design
artworks.description: The image features a square area in the top right corner with an abstract design of fluid, squiggly lines. The design resembles a snake and is accompanied by the text "PIERRE ROCHE TROIS GYPSOGRAPHIES." The rest of the image is a blank, pale background, emphasizing the contrasting texture and design within the square.

artworks.title: Aphrodite
artworks.description: The image depicts a nude woman standing upright. One arm is raised, touching her hair, while the other rests by her side. Her facial features are indistinct in the artistic style. Her hair is long and wavy. The woman has no visible clothing or jewelry and is surrounded by ocean waves. Birds fly around her in the sky, which is a mix of orange and blue tones. The background shows abstract forms creating a seascape setting with a textured appearance.

artworks.title: Colosses de Memnon (Thebes)
artworks.description: This is a painting of two indistinct figures sitting in a desert landscape beneath a vast sky. The painting depicts a broad expanse of land that features two dark, seated forms that are abstract in nature against a warm, orange horizon line that contrasts with the pale, largely unembellished sky above. The area directly beneath the figures is textured with horizontal strokes in muted earthy tones, suggesting an uneven, possibly arid terrain.

artworks.title: Danseuse Cobodgienne (Cambodian Dancer)
artworks.description: This is a painting of an abstract figure in a seated, cross-legged pose. The figure is predominantly rendered in white against a textured, earthy brown background. The figure's arms are symmetrically outstretched upwards and sideways. The figure appears to be wearing an ornate headpiece or crown. Surrounding the figure is a subtle, flowing line. The painting has a minimalist aesthetic with a focus on shape and form.

artworks.title: Diane au levrier (Diana and a Greyhound)
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-length representation of a nude figure in profile, standing with one arm raised and the other lowered. The figure's facial features are indistinct due to the style of the artwork, and the hair appears to be short or sculpted closely to the head. The figure is holding an unidentified form or possibly drapery with the lower hand, and there is a flowing form extending from the raised arm. No clothing or jewelry is visible as the figure is nude. Around the figure, there is a textured, reddish-brown background that contrasts with the lighter shade of the body. The image is framed within a rectangular border on paper, and the rest of the background is a plain, light-colored paper with some handwritten text near the bottom.

artworks.title: Femme et Cygne, 22 fevrier 1912, Diner Japonaise (Woman and Bird, 22 February 1912, J
artworks.description: The image shows a stylized drawing of a woman in profile, with her full body visible in a sitting position. Her legs are bent, and she is wearing a wide-brimmed hat. She is wearing a form-fitting dress, and there are abstract shapes around her. The text includes "22 Février 1918" and "Diner Japonais," all embossed in the same style as the drawing. In the bottom right corner, there is a small emblem with the letter "R" inside. The background is a light, uniform color.

artworks.title: Notre Dame du Folgoet (Our Lady of Folgoet)
artworks.description: The image shows abstract forms including a vertical rectangle on the left with the text "O DITROUN GUERHEZ MARI" and a textured area in the center with a human-like figure. The design resembles a statue-like figure of a woman holding a child, both wearing detailed crowns. Draped lines suggest robes, similar to traditional religious iconography. The shading and texture create depth and dimension, resembling embossed or relief-style art.

artworks.title: Saint Agathe (Saint Agatha)
artworks.description: The image displays a relief-style depiction of a woman shown waist up. She faces forward with her hands together in a prayer-like gesture at chest level. Her facial features are somewhat indistinct due to the artistic style, and she appears to have a gentle expression. She has long hair partially covered by a cloth or headdress, and wears draped, flowing clothing. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background has inscriptions, including "SAINTE AGATHE PRIEZ POUR NOUS," in a monochromatic, textured style on a light background.

artworks.title: Sainte Azenor de Goelo
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure with flowing hair, surrounded by waves. The text "SAENT BREIZ" and "SANTES AZENOR" are included in the image. The central figure stands on a raised platform amidst swirling waves. The style is reminiscent of woodcuts or early printmaking techniques, characterized by bold outlines and a textured surface. The text in capitalized letters adds to the dramatic and historical feel of the piece.

artworks.title: Saint Brieuc
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure holding a staff and a book. The image features a figure dressed in robes, holding a staff in one hand and a book in the other. The figure is centered against a textured background and is surrounded by text, "SAENT BREIZ" above and additional text below. The drawing has earthy tones, giving it an aged appearance. The details suggest a depiction of a holy or revered individual.

artworks.title: Saint Euson
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure seated within a rectangular frame with text. The central figure wears a robe and a crown, holds a circular object, and appears as if etched into a sepia-toned background. The image is bordered by the text "SAENT BREIZ" above and "S'EUSON AVOCAT" below. The style gives it a rustic or aged look, hinting at historical or religious associations. The texture and shading make it look antique, emphasizing the figure's solemn and possibly sacred nature.

artworks.title: Saint Geldas
artworks.description: The image shows a person kneeling on one knee, facing sideways with their head slightly turned upwards. They hold a book in one hand and a long staff in the other. The person wears a flowing robe. The background features a textured, possibly water-like surface. The words "SANT GILDAS" are at the top. Additional text is at the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Saint Guenole
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures - an adult and a child, in a full-length stance. The adult is standing slightly turned to the right, holding a staff in one hand with a curved top, and pointing with the other arm towards the upper right corner. The adult's face is in profile, with short, closely cropped hair, wearing a white robe and bare feet. The child is standing in front, looking to the left with their head slightly raised, dressed in a long red garment with short hair and bare feet. In the background is a dark textured surface with text at the top and bottom saying "SAENT BREIZ" and "S. GUENOLE ABAD." The image has a sketch-like or pastel quality with soft edges and a parchment paper effect.

artworks.title: Saint Guenole
artworks.description: The image shows a horizontal landscape with architectural structures including pointed rooftops and a larger building to the right. The artwork appears to be an etching or print with textured strokes creating a roughened effect. The color palette is beige and black. The sky above is mostly empty with a few elongated clouds creating a sense of vastness and simplicity.

artworks.title: Saint Herve
artworks.description: The image shows a person from head to toe, standing upright. The individual is an older male with a long beard and a head covering, dressed in a long robe and holding a staff. The stone or woodcut image has an ornate style, similar to an engraving or relief. The background appears textured, with the name "SANT HERVE" inscribed at the top. There is a smaller figure next to him, perhaps holding an instrument. The overall tone is monochrome, with a rustic or ancient appearance.

artworks.title: Saint Iltud
artworks.description: The image is a print of a full-length standing figure identified as Sant Iltud Abbas. The person is facing forward, holding a staff in one hand and a book in the other. The figure has subtle facial features, with discernible eyes, a nose, and a mouth, framed by a short, possibly curly hairstyle. They are dressed in a robe with wide sleeves, with fabric gathering at the arms and body. The background features a textured landscape and some faint structures or details in the distance. The text "SANT ILTUD ABBAS" is displayed in large, stylized letters beside the figure. The print is set against an aged paper background.

artworks.title: Saint Patrice
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing, wearing a hooded garment and holding a staff or shepherd's crook. The background is dark and textured. There is yellowish text at the top reading "SANTO PATRIK," and handwritten text at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Saint Tugdual
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper body of a person in profile view, facing left. The individual's head and shoulders are visible, with their body slightly turned. The face has pronounced features, including a nose and defined chin, with hair styled back. The person is dressed in draped fabric, possibly a robe or toga. The background has a rough texture with the text "SANT TUGDUVAL" in bold, uppercase letters at the top. The image appears to be a sepia-toned print with an aged appearance.

artworks.title: Sirene (Hippocampe)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a mermaid illustration titled "La Sirene." The image features a mermaid with a long tail extending vertically across the composition. The upper part of the figure is pale, with an arm reaching towards the text "LA SIRENE" above. The background is textured brown, adding depth to the organic shapes. The image is stylized with an etching-like quality, reminiscent of Odilon Redon's style.

artworks.title: Souhaits (Aspirations)
artworks.description: The image depicts an abstract composition of a central elongated, vertical shape surrounded by curving lines resembling tendrils or vines. Ornate, flowing patterns flank the central motif, creating a symmetrical design. Smaller circular shapes are situated above and below, with the numbers "1906" at the top. The word "SOUHAITS" is inscribed on the left side, adding a textual element to the design. The arrangement of shapes suggests connections to natural forms and decorative motifs.

artworks.title: Benjamin Franklin
artworks.artist: Max Rosenthal after Charles Willson Peale
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated, turned slightly to the side but facing forward. His features include a prominent forehead, deeply set eyes, round spectacles, and shoulder-length gray hair. He is dressed in an ornate dark coat over a light-colored shirt, holding a thin metal rod. Beside him on a table are two ink pots and a quill. The background features a draped curtain and a view of a darkened sky with a jagged line.
